passage.text: Hi, Emma! I moved in on Friday.
passage.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈɛmə! aɪ ˌmuːvd ˈɪn ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ.

passage.text: My new room is small, but it's clean, and it's a ten-minute walk from the university.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈnuː ˈruːm ɪz ˈsmɔːl, bʌt ɪts ˈkliːn, ənd ɪts ə ˌtɛn ˌmɪnɪt ˈwɔːk frəm ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

passage.text: But there's a problem: my neighbor is very noisy.
passage.reading: bʌt ðɛrz ə ˈprɑːbləm: maɪ ˈneɪbər ɪz ˈvɛri ˈnɔɪzi.

passage.text: He plays the guitar and sings every night until two o'clock in the morning!
passage.reading: hiː ˈpleɪz ðə ɡɪˈtɑːr ənd ˈsɪŋz ˈɛvri ˈnaɪt ənˈtɪl ˈtuː əˈklɑːk ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ!

passage.text: Last night, I knocked on his door, but he didn't answer.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈnaɪt, aɪ ˈnɑːkt ɑːn hɪz ˈdɔːr, bʌt hiː ˈdɪdənt ˈænsər.

passage.text: This morning, I complained to the landlord.
passage.reading: ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, aɪ kəmˈpleɪnd tə ðə ˈlændlɔːrd.

passage.text: He's going to talk to my neighbor tomorrow.
passage.reading: hiːz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈtɔːk tə maɪ ˈneɪbər təˈmɑːroʊ.
